label: Where the policy seam goes
subgoals: Place the seam at the move generator, outside the acceptance and legality core
Expose read access to state and a typed channel for proposals
Batch plug-in calls so the inner loop stays fast

label: What the core still guarantees
subgoals: Keep legality and cost bookkeeping inside the core
Require golden-design legality and QoR comparison for every new policy
Reject plug-ins whose hidden state breaks determinism

label: Selecting and promoting policies
subgoals: Choose a policy by matching manifests to the design's characteristics
Validate a new policy and record where it helps before promotion
Keep each request at the lowest tier that can serve it
